quotes.text: A really good superintendent does not direct or order or tell. A really good superintendent guides.
The skill set that you need as a successful senior superintendent is 80% technical skills and 20% soft skills.

You graduate from high school, you start an apprenticeship with the carpenters union, and we pay you and teach you at the same time. When you're done in five years, you will be making more money than engineers or architects.
